name: Countdown Timer Dimmer Keypad, 8 Buttons

verification.note: Read from the product having one load, which its group 1 controls, as on other one-load products.

steps.text: Disconnect power at the service panel.
Remove the trim plate and the existing switch or dimmer.
Connect the timer's copper wire to ground with a wire nut or screw.
Connect the timer's white wire to neutral with a wire nut.
Connect the timer's black wire to the hot wire with a wire nut.
Connect the timer's red wire to the switch leg with a wire nut. Controlling a local load is optional.
Carefully screw the timer into the electrical box and replace the trim plate.
Restore power at the service panel.
steps.expect: The timer returns to its last on or off state.

steps.text: Test the timer by pressing the 2 min button.
steps.expect: The lights turn on, flash after 1 minute and turn off after 2 minutes.

notes: A neutral wire is required. Identify all wires before you begin; for 3-way wiring diagrams the Countdown Timer Dimmer Keypad, 8 Buttons 2484D Quick Start Guide refers to another document.

steps.text: Press and hold any button on the timer until its LED begins blinking.

notes: As a controller: then press and hold the SET button on the responder until its LED flashes (on a multi-button device, hold the button of choice until its LED or load flashes). Linked devices turn on when the timer turns on and off when it expires.
As a responder: put the controller in linking mode, then press and hold the timer button for the time the lights should stay on until the lights flash.

steps.text: Have the Hub start ALL-Linking as the controller, for group 0.
Press and hold any button on the timer until its LED begins blinking.
Wait for the Hub to report the new link.
steps.expect: The Hub reports ALL-Linking Completed with the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub send ID Request.
steps.expect: The device answers with its category, subcategory and firmware version

steps.text: Have the Hub send Ping to confirm the link.

notes: This links the Hub's group 0 to the device as a responder; the device makes no link back to the Hub, since this profile lists no group it controls.

To add the device without its SET button, have the Hub send it Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09, cmd2 0x01; extended for an i2CS device) right after it starts ALL-Linking, in place of the SET button step.

verification.note: Assembled from this profile's linking steps and the standard Insteon commands Start ALL-Linking, ID Request and Ping; no document describes adding this product to a Hub.

steps.text: Press and hold the corresponding button on the timer until its LED begins blinking.
Press and hold the same button again for 15 seconds.
Press and hold the SET button on the responder until its LED flashes; on a multi-button device, hold the button of choice until its LED or load flashes.
Pull the SET button out.
Wait 15 seconds.
Push the SET button in and hold it in for 5 seconds.
steps.expect: The lights turn on after 3 seconds.

notes: All programmed links are removed and features return to the factory defaults.

steps.text: Remove the device from every scene, as a responder.

verification.note: Read from how Insteon links work: a device left in a scene keeps links to it in other devices' ALL-Link databases. No document describes removing this product.

steps.text: Remove the device from its scenes first, so no other device keeps links to it.
Have the Hub start unlinking for group 0 (Start ALL-Linking with link code 0xFF).
Have the Hub send Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09) with cmd2 0x01, for group 1, as an extended message if the device is i2CS.
Wait for the Hub to report that the link is gone.
steps.expect: The Hub reports the device's Insteon ID

verification.note: Assembled from the standard Insteon commands Start ALL-Linking and Enter Linking Mode; no document describes removing this product from a Hub.

notes: Buttons A to H start 2, 5, 10, 15 and 30 minute and 1 and 2 hour timers, and turn the load off.
Turns its load off for a second a minute before a timer ends, unless that's turned off.
sources: Countdown Timer Dimmer Keypad, 8 Buttons 2484D Quick Start Guide
